If the desk overrode me, the ceiling would be a $5 ticket, a 20% stop, and a 15-minute hold, since round-trip costs of 1.4-5.1% on a shallow pool eat much of any short move. But the base rates here (roughly 20% expected loss per random post-graduation buy) and the churn signature make this a skip.
memos.scout:
The honest case for buying is weak. Here's what the brief shows:

For: the coin is alive at 30 minutes and up 167% over that window. Buyers were broad during the curve (873 buyers, top-3 share just 7.9%, top-5 buyers 8.8% of post-graduation buys) and the graduation was fairly slow, not a rushed bundle. Last 15 minutes show 1,254 buyers against 1,113 sellers, with 785 SOL bought.

Against: net flow over the last 15 minutes is roughly flat (+16.75 SOL on 785 bought, return -0.55%), and sellers are nearly keeping pace with buyers (sell/buy ratio 0.92 post-graduation). The coin is already 28% off its 30-minute high, which is the kind of dip most of these coins never recover. A launch bot was present, bundle share is 24%, and the pool is thin at 145 SOL, so a $20 ticket would face meaningful slippage on a 1.4-5.1% round trip. The post-graduation buy volume is real, but it is being matched by selling, not absorbed.

Verdict: no strong case. Demand exists but is not clearly accumulating, and the base rates for this profile are poor. I'd skip.
memos.skeptic:
Most likely loss path: a slow distribution into the 28% drawdown from the 30-minute high. Over the last 15 minutes, sell SOL (768.89) nearly matched buy SOL (785.64), with net flow of only +16.75 SOL and sellers (1113) close to buyers (1254). That is churn and exit liquidity, not accumulation. Price is -0.55% over the window, so the 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost would be unrecovered even if it stabilizes.

Supporting numbers: the 30-minute return of +167% is largely behind it, the sell-to-buy ratio in the first two minutes after graduation was 0.92 with a launch bot present, and the bundle share is 24%. Pool depth of 144.6 SOL is thin for a $20 ticket to exit cleanly. Pass.
